leads.title: Attorney General Directive 1953, Supreme Court ruling 1963, and 1988 Knesset repeal of sodomy ban
leads.documents: Decriminalization of consensual same-sex sexual activity; age of consent 16 for homosexual and heterosexual acts
leads.detail: Inherited Buggery Act 1533; 1953 directive by Attorney General Haim Cohn to refrain from enforcement; 1963 Supreme Court ruling not to apply law to consenting adults in private; formal repeal by Knesset in 1988 by omitting from criminal code. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Israeli Supreme Court decision 2006 on registration of foreign same-sex marriages - Funk-Schlesinger precedent
leads.documents: Israel registers civil marriages including same-sex marriages performed elsewhere for population registry statistics but does not perform same-sex marriages domestically and does not decide recognition of new status
leads.detail: Quoted ruling on role of registration official as collector of statistical material; based on Funk-Schlesinger Case for interfaith marriages abroad. No URL visible.

leads.title: Civil Union Law for Citizens with no Religious Affiliation, 2010
leads.documents: 2010 amendment to marriage law allowing opposite-sex couple with no religious affiliation to form civil union in Israel
leads.detail: Cited as Civil Union Law for Citizens with no Religious Affiliation, 2010. No URL visible.

leads.title: Adoption of Children Law of 1981, Article 25 and Supreme Court ruling 10 January 2005 Jarus-Hakak
leads.documents: Legal basis for lesbian stepchild adoption under special circumstances for good of child; 7-2 Supreme Court win allowing couple to adopt each other's biological children on 12 February 2006; later February 2008 ruling allowing joint adoption of non-biological child
leads.detail: Hebrew: חוק אימוץ ילדים, תשמ"א-1981; Arabic: قانون تبني الأطفال 1981; petition filed Tel Aviv Family Court 1997, District Court loss, Supreme Court acceptance. No URL visible.

leads.title: Israeli Supreme Court February 2020 surrogacy ruling and High Court 11 July 2021 order
leads.documents: Unanimous ruling that exclusion of same-sex couples from surrogacy harms right to equality, gave state one year to amend; July 2018 Knesset bill had expanded to single women but rejected same-sex amendment; 11 July 2021 order amending 2018 Surrogacy Law to enter into force within six months, effective January 2022
leads.detail: July 2018 vote context with PM Benjamin Netanyahu support then opposition; 100,000 protest in Tel Aviv cited. No URL visible.

leads.title: High Court of Justice December 2018 birth certificate ruling - Justice Neal Hendel
leads.documents: Same-sex parents have right to be listed on children's birth certificates; Interior Ministry cannot refuse based on sexual orientation; principle of good of the child requires recording entire family unit
leads.detail: Case of two gay men adopting son; quote on contrast with heterosexual adoptive couple; follow-up July 2018 proposal requiring notice to Interior Ministry rejected by Government. No URL visible.

leads.title: Health Ministry Committee for Sex Reassignment at Sheba Medical Center, Tel HaShomer and 2015 gender-change policy
leads.documents: Gatekeeping machinery for transgender care: public insurance coverage requires approval by committee of endocrinologist, urologist, plastic surgeon organized by Health Ministry; all surgeries performed by Dr. Haim Kaplan; since 2015 transgender people can change legal gender without sex reassignment surgery
leads.detail: Notes stringent opinions causing many to pay out of pocket or go overseas. No URL visible.

leads.title: Knesset June 2013 gender-marker bill and 2024 ID deadname removal law
leads.documents: 2013 bill to eliminate gender markers on National Identity Cards did not pass; 2024 law allowing transgender individuals to remove deadname from ID cards, previously required recording all previous names
leads.detail: Cited as Knesset action June 2013 and 2024. No URL visible.

leads.title: Prohibition of Discrimination in Products, Services and Entry into Places of Entertainment and Public Places Law, 2000; 1992 employment law; 1997 Libel and Slander amendment
leads.documents: Prohibits employment discrimination on sexual orientation 1992 with religious exemptions; broadens defamation prohibition and doubles punishment for violent crime motivated by sexual orientation; prohibits discrimination in products, services and public places
leads.detail: Hebrew: חוק איסור הפליה במוצרים, בשירותים ובכניסה למקומות בידור ולמקומות ציבוריים; Arabic: حظر التمييز في المنتجات والخدمات والدخول إلى أماكن الترفيه والأماكن العامة; April 2020 Beersheba Magistrate's Court print shop compensation case cited as enforcement. No URL visible.

leads.title: Ministry of Health October 2014 statement on conversion therapy and Israel Medical Association January 2019 ban
leads.documents: Ministry states conversion therapy has no scientific evidence and may cause harm, created complaints committee; Medical Association representing ~90% of physicians explicitly banned members from performing conversion therapy; Knesset rejected 2016 ban for minors 37-45, passed first-stage outlaw bill July 2020
leads.detail: February 2017 reports 20 complaints undealt with; MKs Yael German and Eyal Ben-Reuven called committee dysfunctional; July 2019 Education Minister Rafi Peretz endorsement condemned by PM Netanyahu. No URL visible.
